newsitem.title: UK: Nursing Homes Props buys 348 new beds.
newsitem.headline: Nursing Homes Props buys 348 new beds.

text.p: Nursing Homes Properties, the UK's first property investment group to specialise in buying and leasing back modern purpose-built homes, said on Wednesday it was buying six nursing homes with 348 beds for 12.735 million stg.
Nursing Home Properties (NHP) also noted that it was concluding conditional contracts to buy two further nursing homes with 122 beds for 3.78 million stg.

The homes are in Lincolnshire, Carlisle, London, Londonderry, County Down and Dundee. Some have been purchased and leased back to Speciality Care Plc, some to Exceler Healthcare Group Plc and some to Grampian Care Limited.
NHP has investments in 39 nursing homes, with 2,318 beds, with eight operators at a cost of approximately 75 million stg.
